title: Wayfare Pass Tenure and Toll Returns on Wayfare Rides
content:
**Member benefit.** A detour toll return on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** follows the rider's tenure in **Wayfare Pass (rider membership)**, read from the Wayfare Pass membership in force at the request: its status and its enrollment date.

| Membership in force at the request | Enrolled before today | Member tenure multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| in trial, active or pending cancellation status | at least 6 months (established member months) | 1.15 (established tenure multiplier) |
| in trial, active or pending cancellation status | fewer than 6 months | 1.05 (recent tenure multiplier) |
| any other rider (no membership, or a membership in any other status) | — | not changed by tenure |

A membership in trial, active or pending cancellation status enrolled at least 6 months before today multiplies the return by the established tenure multiplier of 1.15; one in those statuses enrolled more recently multiplies it by the recent tenure multiplier of 1.05; any other rider's return is not changed by tenure.

## Cases (hypothetical memberships)

- Active, enrolled 6 months before today: 1.15.
- Active, enrolled 5 months before today: 1.05.
- Paused, enrolled 30 months before today: not changed — the status, not the length of membership, rules it out.
